channel.title: Spaces That Matter — Blog (English)
channel.description: Articles and research on the human performance of workspaces.

item.title: Webinar: can a beautiful office be a bad workspace?
item.description: Spaces That Matter webinar (in French), December 8, 2026 at 12 pm Paris time: how to measure what your offices really bring to employees and the business.

item.title: Why the workspace is a lever for human performance
item.description: Companies invest heavily in their offices. But how many actually measure whether these spaces create value for their teams? The psychological and neurological mechanisms explained.

item.title: Flex office: a promise kept or a collective disillusion?
item.description: Flex office has transformed thousands of offices in France. Yet the data shows that flexible offices can degrade the employee experience. Analysis and possible solutions.

item.title: HQE, WELL, BREEAM vs STM: the difference between an environmental certification and a human label
item.description: HQE, WELL and BREEAM assess the technical performance of the building. Spaces That Matter assesses the human performance of the space. Two complementary but fundamentally different approaches.
